name: gamebuilder
description: Describe a turn-based game, and AI writes it, playtests it in a sandbox, and lets you play and refine it.

scripts.deploy:firebase: npm run build:firebase && firebase deploy --only hosting,auth,firestore:rules
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && python3 tests/browser_fallback_test.py && python3 tests/browser_iframe_test.py
